t: You're at the Liberal Jewish Cemetery in Willesden, on Pound Lane. It was established in 1911 by the Liberal Jewish Synagogue and opened in 1914. There is a Grade II listed war memorial here. Members of the Sassoon and Rothschild families are buried here, and so are several others. They include the author and Zionist Israel Zangwill, the impresario Lew Grade, and the sculptor Benno Elkan, who made the great Menorah outside the Knesset in Jerusalem. Sir Isaac Shoenberg, who led the EMI team behind the 405-line television system used by the BBC from 1936, is also buried here.
